name: archive_command
description: Shell command executed to archive a completed WAL file segment; supports %p (full path) and %f (filename) placeholders.
symptoms: Replication lag due to missing WAL segments

constraints.hard_rule: archive_mode must be 'on' or 'always' for archive_command to take effect

tuning_tips: Set to a reliable, idempotent shell command (e.g., rsync or cp with proper error handling); ensure target directory is writable by the postgres user and has sufficient space; test exit codes rigorously.
